Let

\[
W_g(a)=\sum_{y\in E}(-1)^{g(y)+a\cdot y}.
\]

First compute the transform:

\[
(\mathcal F f_{M,g})(u,v)
=2^{-8}\sum_{x,y}(-1)^{x\cdot My+g(y)+x\cdot v+y\cdot u}.
\]

The inner sum over \(x\) is zero unless \(My=v\), in which case it is \(2^8\). Hence

\[
(\mathcal F f_{M,g})(u,v)
=(-1)^{g(M^{-1}v)+(M^{-1}v)\cdot u}.
\]

So \(\mathcal F f_{M,g}=f_{M,g}\) iff, for all \(u,v\),

\[
(M^{-1}v)\cdot u = (Mv)\cdot u
\]

and

\[
g(M^{-1}v)=g(v).
\]

Thus

\[
M^{-1}=M,\qquad g(Mv)=g(v).
\]

So we must count pairs \((M,g)\) where \(M\) is an involution preserving \(g\).

The Walsh condition says \(g\) is a nonsingular quadratic form on \(\mathbb F_2^8\) of plus type, since \(W_g(0)=16\). All such \(g\) are equivalent under \(\operatorname{GL}(8,2)\). Therefore the number of admissible pairs is

\[
\#\{\text{plus-type }g\}\cdot \#\{\text{involutions in }O^+(8,2)\}.
\]

Now

\[
|O^+(8,2)|
=2\cdot 2^{12}(2^4-1)(2^2-1)(2^4-1)(2^6-1)
=348364800,
\]

and

\[
|\operatorname{GL}(8,2)|
=\prod_{i=0}^7(2^8-2^i)
=5348063769211699200.
\]

Hence

\[
\#\{\text{plus-type }g\}
=\frac{|\operatorname{GL}(8,2)|}{|O^+(8,2)|}
=15351906304.
\]

It remains to count involutions in \(O^+(8,2)\). Write \(M=I+N\), so \(N^2=0\). If \(r=\operatorname{rank}N\), then \(0\le r\le 4\). Counting by the totally isotropic image \(R=\operatorname{im}N\), one obtains:

\[
\begin{array}{c|c}
r & \#\{M\in O^+(8,2): M^2=I,\ \operatorname{rank}(M-I)=r\}\\
\hline
0 & 1\\
1 & 120\\
2 & 9135\\
3 & 330750\\
4 & 4477680
\end{array}
\]

Thus

\[
\#\{\text{involutions in }O^+(8,2)\}
=1+120+9135+330750+4477680
=4817686.
\]

Therefore the number of distinct functions is

\[
15351906304\cdot 4817686
=73960664074092544.
\]

\[
\boxed{73960664074092544}
\]
